----Petitioners  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Gulam Rasool S/o Khudabaksh, R/o Kikarwali, Teh.
 Sangria, Dist. Hanumangarh, Raj.
 ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. J.S. Khichi For Respondent(s) : Mr. Vikram Sharma, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN MONGA Order (Oral) 15/07/2024 1.

Petitioners are before this Court seeking quashing of FIR No.218/2023 dated 18.04.2024 registered at Police Station Sangria, District Hanumangarh for the alleged offences under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC.
2.
At the very outset, learned Public Prosecutor states that after investigation, it has been found that no offences have been committed by the petitioners.
The allegations against them are civil in nature and therefore, a favourable negative final report has already been prepared.
Same shall be filed in due course before the competent court.
In view of the aforesaid statement, nothing survives before this court for adjudication and the misc. petition is disposed of as infructuous.
Stay petition also stands disposed of.

(ARUN MONGA),J 67-AnilKC/-
